messages.subject:
=?UTF-8?Q?Re=3A_GSoC_2026_Proposal_=E2=80=93_Breeze=2Daware_AI_Agent_Ski?=
	=?UTF-8?Q?lls_for_Apache_Airflow?=
messages.body:
Hi Anuj,

Thank you for your interest in the Airflow GSoC project.

I recommend discussing your proposal ideas or questions in the `#gsoc`
channel on the official Apache Airflow Slack. This helps us avoid
overloading the dev mailing list, where many larger feature and
release‑management discussions take place. I will also share common
questions from other contributors there.

Best,
Jason

On Thu, Mar 12, 2026 at 9:52 PM Anuj Soni <sonianuj287@gmail.com> wrote:

> Hello Jason,
>
> I am preparing a proposal for Google Summer of Code 2026 under the Apache
> Airflow project.
>
> I have been exploring the idea discussed in issue #62500 regarding
> AI-agent interaction with the Breeze development environment. As part of
> this, I implemented an initial prototype focused on introducing a
> Breeze-aware skill system that allows AI agents and automated tools to
> interact with Airflow’s development workflows in a structured way while
> keeping Breeze as the single source of truth.
>
> I have prepared a draft proposal based on this work and would greatly
> appreciate any feedback or suggestions you might have before the submission
> deadline.
>
> If you have time to review it, I would be very grateful for your guidance
> on whether the scope and direction align well with the project’s goals.
>
> Thank you for your time, and I look forward to contributing further to the
> Airflow community.
>
> Best regards,
> Anuj Soni
>
